svg.title: Hashly
svg.desc: Primary app-icon surface per the brand sheet: gold background, ink glyph. On a gold background, the gold-accent right vertical disappears, so both verticals render in ink (matches app.jsx's MarkGeometric color=INK accent=INK on bg=GOLD). Source for cargo tauri icon's 1024x1024 input — see follow-up issue for the rasterization step.
